translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Hebreos
book.title: Kart daa bseḻ' to beṉ' lao beṉ' hebreoka', beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesucrístona'

content: Ley c̱he dii Moiséza' chzajniin cho' lat' c̱he dii wenka' zi' za' gon Chioza', na' bi nakan ka daa nak dowalj. Daan, bi chzaki leya' yiyonan beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' beṉ'ka' yog' yiz chitgake' bayix̱'ka' chzangakile' we'gake' Chioza' ka nllian bia' gongake'.
Sheḻ' daa chitgake' bayix̱'ka' gok bix̱is biyiban saaxya c̱he'ka', aga wyooch yic̱hjgake' nan nakgake' beṉ' saaxya na' bich betgake' bayix̱'ka', sheḻ'ka'.
Per daa betgake' bayix̱'ka' lao Chioza' ze twiz wej bisa'lan lall'gake' saaxya c̱he'ka',
ḻa' xc̱hen gooṉka' na' xc̱hen shibka' bi gak yisol yiṉitan saaxyaka'.
Daan, ka bid Crístona' yell-lioni, golle' Chioza':

content.text: Aga cheenchilo' no wit bayix̱' lawo'na' wa izangakile' bichlə dii goṉgake' li',
san ba beno' nad' beṉ' de beli chen kwenc̱he izanid' kwin' lo lazgakin.
Bi chibailo' no wit bayix̱'ka' wa wzeygake'b lawo'na' kwenc̱he wsol wṉito' saaxya c̱he'ka'.
Na'ch wnia' li': “Ka choe' libr c̱ho'na' xtillaa,
Chios c̱ha', ni zoa' kwenc̱he gon' daa cheenilo'.”

content: Na' zigaate wne': “Aga cheenchilo' no wit bayix̱' na' wzeygake'b lawo'na' wa goṉgake' bichlə dii goṉgake' li' kwenc̱he yizi'xeno' xtoḻeeka'”, ḻa'kzi nakgakan daa nllia leya' bia' gongake'.
Na'tech chi'ene': “Chios c̱ha', ni zoa' kwenc̱he gon' daa cheenilo'.” Na' daa golle' ka' zejin bzoe' ka'lə dii gola' ben bx̱ozka' na' bx̱ie' to dii kob lwaayi daa bzoe' ka'lə.
Na' daa ben Jesucrístona' ka cheeni Chioza', be' kwerp c̱he'na' na' wite' shlin shlax̱j ni c̱hecho, kwenc̱he bixi biyech yic̱hjlall'do'chona' lao Chioza'.
Bx̱ozka' chilaḻgakile' choe'la'ogake' Chioza' yog' lla, na' zekizezi chitgake' bayix̱'ka' lawe'na', ḻa'kzi biga gak yisol yiṉitgakan saaxya c̱he'ka'.
San Crístona' bzani kwine' wite' shlin shlax̱j kwenc̱he bsol bṉite' xtoḻ'choka'. Na' ka bibane', jachi'e shḻaa de shḻi c̱he Chioza' gana' chṉabia'lene'ne'.
Na' na' zoe' chbeze' shlak wzoa Chioza' beṉ'ka' chwiyi ḻe' xṉi'ena'.
Na' daa bzani kwine' wite', biyone' beṉ'ka' bene' lall' na' Chioza' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' zejḻi kaṉi.
Na' ḻekzka' Espíritu Sántona' bi'e dill' c̱heyi dga, kana' wne':

content.text: Ki nak daa chc̱heb' gon' c̱hegake' kat' illin llana', na X̱ancho Chioza':
Gon' ka kooshao'gake' ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do'eka' diika' nllia' bia' gongake',

content: Na' wnache':

content.text: Bichga lljadinid' saaxya c̱he'ka' ni xtoḻeeka'.

content: Na' shi Chioza' ba bizi'xene' xtoḻ' beṉ', aga chyalljch witgake' bayix̱'ka' kwenc̱he yiyakxenan.
Le' beṉ' bish' na' le' beṉ' zan', daa ba wit Jesucrístona' na' blalj xc̱hene'na' ni c̱hecho, wak sho'cho do lall'cho Latja' Gana' Zoa Chioza'.

Daa bi'e kwerp c̱he'na', bsalje' to nez kob dii lljwa'n cho' gana' de yeḻ' mban zejḻi kaṉi. Ḻa' kwerp c̱he'na' zaklebin lechaa daa ze ḻoo lill xḻatj Chioza' daa bchez' ka wite', na' zejin byalj latja' gana' zoa Chioza' kwenc̱he gak sho'cho.
Na' Jesucrístona', beena' nak ḻiizelozi bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xen, nake' bx̱oz c̱hecho, cho' nakcho lall' na' Chioza'.

Daan, chiyaḻ' ibig'cho lao Chioza' do yic̱hj do lall'cho, na' wx̱enilall'cho wlebe' cho', ḻa' ṉezicho ba nxi nyech yic̱hjlall'do'chona' daa ba bsol bṉite' xtoḻ'choka', na' ba bixi biyechi kwerp c̱hechoki nis xtila'.
Chiyaḻ' soac̱hec̱hcho goncho lez lljazoalencho Chioza', kon ka choe'cho dill', ḻa' ṉezicho chone' ka nc̱hebe'.
Na' chiyaḻ' yiyiljlall'cho naklə ka goncho gaklen ljwellcho kwenc̱he to tocho gakchi ljwellcho na' gonchcho dii wen.
Bi chiyaḻ' kwej yic̱hjcho daa chdop chllagcho choe'la'ocho Chioza' ka chonz baḻ beṉ', san chiyaḻ' wtip lall' ljwellcho, ¿alechli ṉaa daa chakbe'icho ba zoa yiyed X̱anchona'?
Na' shi ni chonchcho dii mala' daa ṉezicho bi chiyaḻ' goncho kat' ba nombia'cho dill' ḻi c̱he Chioza', bich bi de we'cho Chioza' kwenc̱he yizi'xene' xtoḻ'choka'.
Ḻechozə kwezcho do chall chllebzcho wc̱hoglo Chioza' c̱hecho llana' wzaḻee beṉ'ka' chakzbangakile'ne' lo yi'na' chaḻ'ṉiṉ daa wlliayi' ḻegake'.
Kat' to beṉ' bi chzenague' c̱he ley c̱he dii Moiséza', shi zoa c̱hop shoṉ beṉ' ble'gakile' daa bene', na' chchoglo guete' na' kono gak yiyesh'lallii ḻe'.

¿Alechlin ki gak yeḻ' zak'zi'na' idoḻ' beena' chonile' nakzi Xiiṉ Chioza' na' xc̱hene'na' daa blalje', na' chṉie' zban c̱he Espíritu Sántona' beena' chiyesh'lallii cho'? Ḻa' xc̱hene'nan' bix̱is biyiban yic̱hjlall'do'chona', na' ka blalje'n bx̱ie' dii koba' daa bc̱heb Chioza' gone' c̱hecho.
Na' ṉezicho Chioza' wne': “Nad' yizi'a wzon c̱he beena' chon dii mala', na' wsak'zi'ane' ka chiyaḻ' gak c̱he'.” Na' ḻekzka' wne': “Nad' X̱anle wc̱hogloa' c̱hele, le' nakle yell c̱ha'.”
¡Nyesh'laz wal inlleb gak c̱he beena' wc̱hoglo Chios yaa Chios banna' c̱he' sak'zi'e!
Ḻi lljadini ka nak dii lalljka' ble'ile ka bleble beeni' c̱he Chioza' ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do'lena', na' bizo bizakile' yeḻ' zak'zi'ka' bdiḻ bllagle.
Baḻ-le biya dii ben wna beṉ' le' na' biya dii bc̱hi' bsak'gake' le' lao lkwe' beṉ'. Na' zi baḻ-le goklenle beṉ'ka' biya dii gok c̱hegake'.
Na' biyeshile' beṉ'ka' got' lillyana', na' wzoale mbalaz ḻa'kzi bikaa beṉ' bi dii de c̱hele, daa ṉezile de to dii wench c̱hele yabana' daa bi te c̱heyin.
Daan, bi kwej yic̱hjle daa nx̱enilall'le Chioza', ḻa' to banez choo banez xen si'le c̱heyin.
Chiyaḻ' so sakile diika' chen chle'ile kwenc̱he yiyoll yido gonle ka cheeni Chioza' na' gaki c̱hele daa nc̱hebe' goṉe'.
Ḻa' Cho'a Xtill' Chioza' nan:

content.text: Ba zoa gaoshosh yiyed beena' chiyaḻ' yiyed,
Na' beena' nak beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' daa nonḻilallee nad' ibane' zejḻi kaṉi.
Na' shi bich gonḻilallee nad', bich ile'shiidee.

content: Per cho', aga nakcho ka beṉ'ka' kwiayi' daa chibiigake' bich chonḻilall'gake'ne', san cho' zoacho nonḻilall'chone' yilacho bi kwiayi'cho.
